storyAndLocalDetails.fact: Casa Lola is at 1132 16th Street in Downtown Sacramento.
The venue is near the SAFE Credit Union Convention Center and Memorial Auditorium.
The official brand story describes Casa Lola as a tribute to family and tradition, inspired by a beloved Lola.
storyAndLocalDetails.caution: No name, family relationship, personal biography, hometown or founding date is supplied. Do not invent a grandmother story.

storyAndLocalDetails.fact: The current menu includes tequila and mezcal cocktails, and house horchata, jamaica and seasonal aguas frescas.
The restaurant has indoor seating and a patio; the private-events page lists 132 indoor seats and 160 total seated including the patio.
